mission.description: Learn about what drives us forward

2025.title: Record-Breaking Impact
2025.description: Our most successful summer yet, with unprecedented growth across all metrics. The 96% satisfaction rating reflects our commitment to quality, personalized tutoring that truly makes a difference in students' lives.

2024.title: Expanding Our Reach
2024.description: Steady growth with new highs in tutor and tutee numbers, expanding to new library branches across four of five boroughs. After Summer '24, we realized a new need to expand our social media influence to reach the next levels of impact.

earlier.title: Our Journey Begins
earlier.description: SST was founded by Stuyvesant students passionate about giving back to their community. From our humble beginnings with a handful of tutors at one library branch, we've grown into a city-wide program serving hundreds of students. Through pandemic challenges and beyond, we've remained committed to providing free, quality education to K-9 students across all five boroughs.
earlier.disclaimer: Note: As this website was recently developed, detailed statistics from earlier years are not currently available. We apologize for any inconvenience. Our commitment to transparency means we're working to compile this historical data for future reference.
